No failure mode -- clears the ~0.84 breast FBP floor strongly. DIAGNOSIS: this is a tiny 5.4k-param VN trained on only 400 of 3600 available train cases -> DATA-LIMITED, not capacity-limited (a 5k-param filter bank cannot overfit 400 cases, so more data should still lift it). ONE KNOB: train_n 400 -> 1600 (4x). All else held (T=3, filters=16, kernel=9, lambda_init=0.0097, epochs=30, lr=9.6e-4, batch=2, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). HYPOTHESIS: feeding 4x more training data raises val hr above 0.5777 because the tiny filter bank is data-limited; predict hr > 0.59. BUDGET: max_train_s=1000 hard-caps wall (solver breaks epoch loop at 1000s); at 4x data the loop wall-truncates to ~7 epochs, staying under the 20-min budget + 30-min SLURM kill. batch_size=2 KEPT (512px OOM guard in the RBF-bump loop).
